title: longfellow-vectors mdoc key vector, v1
description: Sidecar for a PEM private key under vectors/mdoc/keys/.

role.description: Position in the ISO 18013-5 trust chain.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sibling .pem file's bytes.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the public key as DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo. Present only when the PEM parsed at write time.

public_key_x.description: Affine coordinate x of the key's public half, lowercase hex. Omitted when the PEM does not parse as an EC P-256 key.

public_key_y.description: Affine coordinate y of the key's public half, lowercase hex. Omitted when the PEM does not parse as an EC P-256 key.

private_key.description: The key's private scalar, lowercase hex. Omitted when the PEM does not parse as an EC P-256 private key.
